claim: The current methodology makes a narrower point than a generic clean-energy claim: the lowest-water path combines non-evaporative cooling with low-water electricity such as wind and solar plus storage.
shortLabel: Lowest-water path combines cooling and power choices
comparisonContext: This keeps the water story from collapsing into cooling alone or electricity supply alone.
scopeNote: Conceptual pathway synthesis from the cited cooling and electricity evidence rather than a single site-specific guarantee.
